planets.name: Wolf 503 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Wolf 503 with a 6-day year, found in 2018.

text.card: Wolf 503 b was found in 2018 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around Wolf 503. Its orbit and size follow Polanski et al. 2021's fit, the archive's default.
